sentences.text: Through: Mr. Sanjeev Sabharwal, APP fo  with SHO in person.
CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 26.02.2026 1.
The applicant/accused seeks regular bail in case FIR No. 563/2024 of Police Station Palam Village for offence under Section 376/506/323 IPC and Section 6 of POCSO Act.

2. In furtherance of last order, a detailed report of DCP, South-West is submitted by learned APP,
which is accepted across the board.
Today, prosecutrix also has appeared on service of notice but she submits that she wants free legal aid to represent herself.
3. This bail application was listed for the first time before predecessor bench on 09.04.2025 and thereafter, continued getting adjourned.

On last date, 16.02.2026 the matter came up before me for the first time and since neither the IO nor the SHO appeared nor even the prosecutrix had been issued notice, matter was adjourned to this date directing service of notice
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 26/02/2026 at 20:42:00 on prosecutrix.
It was made clear that no further adjournment shall be allowed.
But today in order to ensure effective hearing to the prosecutrix, matter has to be adjourned.

4. Relist on 09.03.2026 in Advance List.
5.
In the meanwhile, the IO shall take steps to get the retrieved data copied from the trial court record or FSL record after moving appropriate application there.
6. The SHO present in court shall take the prosecutrix to the office of DHCLSC for immediate appointment of free legal aid counsel so that on the next date matter does not get adjourned.
